purpose: Qualitative confidence in the evidence supporting a candidate, distinct from attractiveness and data coverage. No future-return probability.
BAJA: Any missing required component, experimental/unmatched model, stale/unknown price or input timestamps, insufficient coverage, fragile/unknown ranking, no corrected model-level predictive confirmation, less than half of effective factor weight supported after multiplicity, inconclusive/adverse paired bootstrap or placebo evidence.
MEDIA: All of those gates pass with traceable retrospective evidence. This is preliminary evidence and never independent validation.
ALTA: All MEDIA gates plus at least two preregistered independent confirmations for the exact model specification from different dataset IDs, with corrected p < .05, positive effect and intact, non-early-unsealed provenance. An accumulating LIVE_FORWARD ledger or a high historical return alone is not confirmation.
missing_studies: Expose #44 pending independent observations and missing historical sectors of #48. Do not run unfinished/blind studies, impute evidence, infer missing labels from price performance, or combine p-values.
factor_support: A factor has retrospective support only with positive mean IC and Holm p < .05. Raw p and descriptive classification do not upgrade support. Candidate support details show percentiles >= 50, effective available-block weights and validated contribution points; no change to composite scoring.
model_matching: Saved studies apply only to the frozen 30/35/25/10 hypothesis and its declared universe/scoring version. Other weights/universes stay experimental/unmatched; a ledger phase describes collection, not validation.
production: Retrospective catalogue loaded read-only from checked-in result artifacts and their fingerprints. No independent confirmations supplied automatically in v1: ALTA stays unavailable until a reviewed independent validator exists. Tests of categories use explicitly supplied synthetic evidence only.
calibration: Thresholds are conservative communication rules chosen before implementation; not fitted to CAGR, Sharpe or future outcomes. Not a calibrated statistical probability.
